description: Adds a new session to the agenda of an event the person organizes: `title`, `start`, `end` and `room`, optionally `date` and `speakers`. FIRST CALL WITHOUT `confirm`: the reply is a PREVIEW with a `changeId`, the before and after of each field, how many pass holders would be notified and the exact notice, and nothing changes. Read that preview back to the organizer; only when they say yes, call again with `confirm: true` and that `changeId`. An addition is quiet unless `notify` is true, which notifies pass holders. Only the organizer of the event can change it; anybody else is refused, and the refusal is read out as given. It requires a personal connector token.

changeId.description: REQUIRED with confirm: the changeId the preview returned.

confirm.description: Leave out for the PREVIEW. Only after the organizer says yes to the preview, call again with confirm: true and the changeId.

date.description: OPTIONAL. The day, YYYY-MM-DD, when the event runs more than one day.

eventIdOrName.description: REQUIRED. The event id or the event name as the organizer spells it.

notify.description: OPTIONAL. Quiet by default; true notifies pass holders of the change.

room.description: The room or place label, plain words.

speakers.description: OPTIONAL. Speaker names; a name that matches the event's speakers is linked, any other is kept as a plain name.

start.description: The start: "4:30 PM", or a full timestamp with a time zone. Read in the event's own time zone.

name: event_session_add
title: Add a session (organizers only)
